expected_level_description: You can: - run the business cycle for an executive team - make sure senior leaders' time is focused on the organisation's priorities
You can: - set the process and standards for executive correspondence - handle the most sensitive correspondence, including with regulators, partners, and the media

You can: - take formal minutes of board and committee meetings, including complex or contentious discussion - keep formal meeting records that stand up to audit and inquiry - advise chairs on what the record should show
You can: - support committee meetings, papers, and minutes - keep governance registers up to date
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - track spending against a small budget and raise variances - authorise spending within your limit

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders

You can: - understand the environment and prioritise the most important or high value tasks - use data to inform planning - manage complex internal and external dependencies - provide delivery confidence - remove blockers or impediments that affect plans and can develop a plan for difficult situations - ensure that teams plan appropriately for their capacity
